name: Rejects documentation that misses a user-facing change

item_template.title: [DOC] Review the export documentation
item_template.description: A branch in this repository documents the CSV export. Check it against what the branch actually shipped.
item_template.acceptance_criteria: Given the documentation, when a reader looks for export, then they find what it does and one worked example.

judge_criteria: The reason names something the branch shipped that the documentation does not mention, or a claim that is not true of the code.
The reason says the claim was checked against the source.

notes: Documentation review that reads only the prose approves anything fluent. The second criterion is the difference between reading the docs and checking them.

name: Asks when there is nothing to check
notes: No named change means no diff to check the documentation against, and a review of documentation against nothing always passes.

name: Reviews without writing the documentation

item_template.title: [DOC] Review the helper documentation
item_template.description: A branch in this repository documents a slug helper. Review it.
item_template.acceptance_criteria: Given the documentation, when a reader looks for the helper, then they find what it does.

notes: A reviewer that rewrites the page has approved its own words, and the Technical Writer never sees what was wrong with theirs.
